01// FOCUS

01 / The Bundle

The full bundle is the deliverable, not an isolated model.

Enterprise AI cannot survive in production without the platform underneath it and data authority around it. Selling a model or technique in isolation invites project failure. Factor IO delivers the whole architecture as an integrated bundle: bare-metal GPU clusters, knowledge authority mapping, private local model serving, and mechanical execution controls.

02// PRODUCTION

02 / Operational Reality

Engineered for local security, air-gapped systems and compliance.

When sensitive corporate data cannot leave your network or be billed on unpredictable API tokens, local on-premise AI is the only viable architecture. We address the hard operational questions before installation begins:

  1. ?

    Where does the model run?

    Strictly on your private servers or local Kubernetes clusters—using optimized local runtimes (vLLM, Triton, Ollama) with zero outbound data leakage.

  2. ?

    Which document is authoritative?

    Source authority and document lifecycle are settled before indexing, preventing hallucinated answers from obsolete company policies.

  3. ?

    Who is permitted to see what?

    Retrieval filters enforce existing active directory and RBAC permissions mechanically at query time, not by prompting the model.

  4. ?

    What happens when hardware fails?

    High availability, failover domains, and automated recovery are engineered into the Kubernetes cluster from Day 1.

03// SERVICES

03 / The Four Pillars

The platform first, the data foundation, then sovereign AI.

Every layer reinforces the others. You can engage us for the complete turnkey rollout or a specific phase aligned with your roadmap.

  1. 01

    Kubernetes & GPU Platform

    The platform your applications need, including Kubernetes and GPU infrastructure. It is designed to carry whatever the business runs on it rather than one workload in particular. Capacity, recovery, upgrades and day-to-day ownership are part of the design.

  2. 02

    Private Local AI Implementation

    On-premise inference engines, model quantization, local embeddings, and GPU capacity optimization with predictable, zero-token cost and total data sovereignty.

  3. 03

    Knowledge and Authority Mapping

    Make your organisation's information useful to AI: which sources to trust, who can access them, and how to keep them current before algorithmic indexing.

  4. 04

    AI Governance and Controls

    Decide what AI may do on its own and when a person needs to approve the next step. We design controls around those decisions, including access, review and deterministic refusal.
